page.layout: One printed page of text in a single column; running head at top; faint show-through text in the right margin (from the facing page, not transcribed) and a digitiser's banner below, not transcribed.

main_text.p: Contra tamen facit, quod dentatæ illæ facetiæ cuniculos agant ad arcem Amicitiæ demoliendam: Ex illis in convicia & jurgia facilis & trita femita : & ab his porro ad rixas, ad simultates, ad indictas & apertas inimicitias itur : & ut sit aliquid, quod præcipitem hunc cursum remoretur, ut ut fiftant, antequam crebrius utrimque puncti exulcerentur animi; tamen Manet altâ mente repostum, & supra crudam injuriam, digestu malignum est, quod cum mordaci joco permiscetur ludibrium : Apertam contumeliam extenuat infe-rentis ira, concitatioque, & turbatæ mentis impotentia ; joco tectam, deliberati animi aggravat simulatio & perversitas : quæ sete-riò

page.notes: Right margin carries only faint show-through from the facing page; no printed marginal notes legible. Words in the line "ut ut fiftant" and "Manet altâ mente" are as printed; "seriò" is partly obscured at the line end and read as "riò" with a catchword-like tail, so treated as a line-end word and left as printed. Line "ad indictas" may read "indicatas"; the scan shows "indictas".
